prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Post-Adoption Certificate Step: Reorder the sign-in screen to take place immediately after the adoption certificate stage rather than before photo upload.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Quality Verification Stage Screen: Add a dedicated photo clarity verification screen between upload photos and adoption certificate to validate image rendering before pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_check": {"headline": "Photo Quality Check", "body": "Ensure your photo has good lighting and clear features for optimal pet rendering.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Confirm Photo", "action": "next"}]}}
2: [home, redesign] Interactive Hatching Chamber Waiting Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout interactive hatching chamber with real-time progress indicators.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Pet is Hatching", "body": "Your desktop companion is being crafted and prepared for your screen.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Spawn Guided Stage: Transform the home intro screen into a stage-based onboarding flow that guides users step-by-step on how to locate, spawn, and control their desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Welcome Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Learn how to position your pet, access quick controls, and customize interaction settings.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:desktop_guide"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Restoration Security Copy: Update sign-in headline and hint to explicitly reassure returning users that signing in restores missing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets", "hint": "Use your existing account email to automatically recover your pet collection."}}
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Outcome Time Expectation Hint: Add a informative hint under choose_path options stating estimated creation time for preset vs custom paths.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Preset path takes ~1 minute. Custom pet creation takes ~3 minutes."}}
6: [home, notification] Desktop Hatch Ready System Notification Prompt: Enable system readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users get notified when background rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll notify your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to join you!"}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Badge Reward: Add an official guardian badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Guardian Certified", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
8: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Preparation Readiness Time Indicator: Display active progress bars and estimated completion timer on the waiting room screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Story Welcome Two Column Layout: Change the initial story intro screen to a two-column layout highlighting companion choices and setup overview side-by-side.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a ready-made companion or bring your own pet to life on your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Moving sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed under rule 4.
Adding a photo verification screen inside onboarding is permitted under rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout while continuing to show the pet is being made is allowed under rule 2 and rule 4.
Expanding the home intro stage within onboarding is explicitly permitted under rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy to inform users about restoring saved pets is compliant with all rules.
Adding creation time hints to choose_path does not violate any rules.
Adding ready notifications on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under rule 4.
Adding an official guardian badge to the certificate maintains the official stamp concept and complies with all rules.
Displaying active progress and completion timers for real waits is permitted under rule 4 and rule 5.
Redesigning the story screen layout while preserving its job of introducing the pet is allowed under rule 2 and rule 4.
